about: fk-gallery's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk9-reload-while-loading
mutants.from:
case Loading:
			// The load in flight answers this visit too.
mutants.rule: A visit while the catalog loads asks for no second load (test ReenteringWhileLoadingAsksNoMore; law CatalogueLoadsOncePerVisit).

mutants.name: fk9-gallery-stay-loads
mutants.from:
case (Gallery, Gallery):
		// A stay on the gallery is no entry.
mutants.rule: Only an entry into the gallery loads the catalog, not a stay (law CatalogueLoadsOncePerVisit).

mutants.name: fk9-stay-always-refetches
mutants.rule: A stay on a painting with the same id loads nothing (test StayingWithTheSameIdDoesNotRefetch; law StayRefetchesOnlyOnIdChange).

mutants.name: fk9-stay-never-refetches
mutants.rule: A stay on a painting with another id loads it (test StayingWithANewIdRefetches).

mutants.name: fk9-empty-draft-saved
mutants.rule: Leaving the studio with an empty draft saves nothing (test LeavingAnEmptyStudioSavesNothing).

mutants.name: fk9-save-on-stay
mutants.rule: Staying in the studio is no exit and saves nothing (law LeavingStudioAlwaysSaves).

mutants.name: fk9-stale-answer-taken
mutants.rule: An answer for another painting than the one loading is ignored (test AStaleAnswerForAnotherIdIsIgnored).

mutants.name: fk9-stale-answer-stays
mutants.to:
if l.ID != p.ID {
				return Stay[Site]{Next: s}
mutants.rule: A stale answer is ignored, not taken as a stay on the same site; only test AStaleAnswerForAnotherIdIsIgnored tells them apart.

mutants.name: fk9-log-unbounded
mutants.rule: The log keeps the last 20 navigations (law LogKeepsTheLastTwenty).

mutants.name: fk9-studio-parses-home
mutants.rule: Every route of the site prints to a path that parses back to it (law RoutesRoundTrip).

mutants.name: fk9b-exited-names-the-next
mutants.rule: A navigation's Exited badge names the route left, as upstream's exitedAny (cases).

mutants.name: fk9b-stay-is-an-entry
mutants.rule: A stay on a painting with another id is no entry: its badge is the stay alone, as upstream's enteredAny (cases: Painting 3 → Painting 4).

mutants.name: fk9b-next-is-this
mutants.rule: Next → goes to the next painting (cases).

mutants.name: fk9b-previous-of-the-first
mutants.rule: The first painting has no ← Previous (case scenes: painting 1).

mutants.name: fk9c-short-draft-unsaved
mutants.rule: Leaving the studio saves any draft that is not empty, one letter too (law LeavingStudioAlwaysSaves; the cases type longer drafts).

mutants.name: fk9c-saved-not-kept
mutants.rule: The work's answer to a save is the draft last saved (law LeavingStudioAlwaysSaves; cases).

mutants.name: fk9c-save-takes-longer
mutants.rule: The work saves in 300 ms, as upstream's sleep (cases: the save's answer at its time).

mutants.name: fk9c-due-forgotten
mutants.from: js = js.Append(if j.Seq == d.Seq { Job{..j, Due: Some[time.Time]{Value: d.At}} } else { j })
mutants.to: js = js.Append(if j.Seq == -d.Seq { Job{..j, Due: Some[time.Time]{Value: d.At}} } else { j })
mutants.rule: A job keeps its due time across navigations: a navigation during a load does not start it again (cases).
